rules: Authored before any scoring run against this set; never use it to tune prompts, retrieval, policies or scorer thresholds.
A run on this set is a gate. Any edit to holdout.json changes the hash and must be a deliberate, reviewed re-freeze with a new date and a note here.
Disjoint from development.json and evaluation.json (ids, domains, business questions).
limitations: 45 cases in 5 small-business domains, English only, single provider/model per run: not a general measure of answer quality.
Pattern/substring checks are a proxy; a human rubric review of a sample is still required (docs/evidence/l1.4).
